title: Designer Gulch Condo | Pool + Free Parking
description:
Welcome to Bluebird & Barrels, a stylish Gulch hideaway designed by Nashville’s own Megan Soto, just minutes from downtown. This 1-bedroom condo plus bunk room sleeps 6 comfortably and includes a pool, fitness room, gated parking, and assigned spot. Walk to nearby restaurants, coffee shops, bars, and hot spots, then come home to drinks on the balcony, dinner with a view, and the perfect place to unwind.

The space
Bluebird & Barrels is your stylish Nashville home base, a polished Gulch View condo with designer details, pool views, and resort style amenities just minutes from the city’s best restaurants, bars, coffee shops, and music spots! Enjoy a private balcony overlooking the pool, fully equipped kitchen, Keurig coffee station and tea, smart TVs, Pyle speakers, keyless entry, assigned garage parking, and access to Illume’s seasonal pool, courtyard, lounge, grill, and fitness room. 

Perfect for girls’ trips, birthday weekends, concerts, couples’ getaways, and an easy Nashville escape.

Sleeping arrangements:
🛏️ King bedroom with smart TV and connecting bathroom, sleeps 2
🛏️ Queen over queen bunk room, sleeps 4
🛋️ Pull out sofa in living room, sleeps 2

Nearby:
Minutes from The Gulch, WeHo, 12 South, Broadway, Downtown, restaurants, rooftops, coffee shops, bars, and live music spots.

Guest access
There is nothing off limits! Keyless entry, and assigned parking spot

Other things to note
Newly redesigned, luxurious condo with everything you need for an amazing time. 

5 min walk to The Gulch
1 mile to Broadway
1/2 mile to 12 South
